capabilities: Run Go code blocks and display output
Insert Go snippets from share links or snippet IDs
Configure a custom Go Playground API endpoint
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that using the plugin means agreeing to the Go Playground terms of service; code sent via run/format/share is executed by the configured external API. README is bilingual (English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese) and includes build/contributing instructions.
problem: Obsidian cannot execute or format Go code in notes, so testing snippets requires leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Run, format, and share Golang code snippets using the Go Playground API.

summary: Runs, formats, and shares Go code from fenced code blocks using the Go Playground API, and imports snippets from Playground share links.
